implementation: Fresh indoor confirmation can announce an unmarked landmark and its floor, the next recorded landmark, a connector exit recheck, or a manual arrival check.
Existing recorded turn cues still require a confirmed walking segment and current matching evidence.
A manual blocked-passage report pauses replay, revokes position and direction, clears notes and in-progress playback, requests camera stop, and offers stop-and-ask-for-help guidance.
A camera stop without acknowledgement blocks replay resume until stop has been confirmed. Explicit resume requires fresh position confirmation.

widgetAssertions: Ambiguous matches produce no confirmed checkpoint cue.
A fresh unmarked match announces the next recorded landmark once via simulated VoiceOver, then pause removes the cue.
Blocked passage withdraws position, direction and notes, cancels audio, and announces help once via VoiceOver or App TTS.
A failed native stop acknowledgement prevents restart until Stop is retried.
Explicit resume leaves confirmation and travel-direction attestation cleared.

humanAcceptance: deferred by user for a combined session
